title: Have Thoughts on the Emmy’s Red Carpet? Join Our Readers in the Comments.
summary: Television’s biggest stars have walked the carpet. Now that you’ve seen what everyone is wearing and voted for your favorite looks, we invite you to comment on a few of the styles.
